blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Typhoon Rosal, internationally named ‘Champi,’ is forecast to bring rains and gusty winds over Batanes on Saturday, October 24, the state weather bureau said. In its 5 a.m. weather advisory, the Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (Pagasa) reported that Rosal may continue to affect Batanes as it traverses over the sea east of Taiwan. Tropical Cyclone Wind Signal No. 1 remained raised over Batanes, which means strong winds may pose minimal to minor threats to life and property.
